notes: equals is read as identity (a firm rule: whatever equals a number is that number), so e^(iπ) takes the sign of the value it equals. Only 1 and −1 are distinct. The sign query is the only dl query.

fol.notes: The value of e^(iπ) is the model's belief, a constant eipi; i⁴ and cos 0 are stored values (constants), and + is built-in (nothing changes addition). 'equals' is equality of values.

i4.says: i to the fourth power equals 1.

label_corrections.why: Equality of two named values through transitive 'equals' (identity, with 1 and −1 distinct individuals): the HermiT encoding already handles this pattern (the identity rule of q3).
Same as q0: e^(iπ) = 1 and cos 0 = 1, so they are the same individual; no arithmetic.
